name: NDF E-commerce
description: NDF ecommerce, product recommendations and delivery integration capability for Frappe v16 deployments.

notes: Optional ecommerce capability layered on top of dhana-base-v16.
dt_ecommerce and dt_recomendations are required applications within this capability.
dt_delivery is included as an optional application.
dt_ecommerce provides the primary NDF storefront implementation.
dt_recomendations provides product recommendation and interaction analysis functionality.
dt_delivery provides delivery provider integration, fulfilment and warehouse-aware delivery functionality.
dt_delivery is currently maintained locally and must not be included in production builds until its repository is published and an immutable commit is resolved.
All applications must pass Frappe v16 compatibility validation before production locking.

applications.name: dt_ecommerce
applications.notes: Primary NDF ecommerce application. Provides storefront themes, homepage, catalogue, product detail pages, wholesale pricing, cart enhancements and storefront APIs.

applications.name: dt_recomendations
applications.notes: NDF product recommendation engine. Provides interaction tracking, recommendation generation and product discovery functionality. Required for this ecommerce capability.

applications.name: dt_delivery
applications.notes: NDF delivery integration application. Currently maintained locally. Intended to provide delivery provider adapters, including Tumaboda, warehouse-aware fulfilment and delivery quotation integration. Publish the repository and validate its dependencies before enabling production builds.
